description: This file defines a PHP class Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterResource that provides a method to register template resources within the Smarty templating engine, allowing dynamic association of resource handlers to resource types.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterResource
classes.description: A class providing a method to register resource handlers for Smarty templates, enabling dynamic resource management.

methods.name: registerResource
methods.description: Registers a resource handler for a given resource type within the Smarty template system, updating the registered_resources array.
